source_notes: Pre-FID project; anticipated FID has slipped from 2025 to 2026. As of 2026 the consortium (Nisga'a Nation, Rockies LNG, Western LNG; TotalEnergies/Shell binding offtake ~4 mtpa) is targeting FID in 2026 (variously reported as 'summer 2026' / 'by year's end' / 'not far off'); a non-binding 1 mtpa SEFE/Germany deal was announced May 2026. FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Corroborated off-GEM by Natural Gas Intelligence (two distinct articles) and Energy Intelligence, all naming a 2026 FID target. Upgraded yellow->green: >=2 independent publishers each carry the 2026 FID target (verified via url_verifier on token '2026'). The precise month remains contested but the FID year is consistently 2026.
